",
  "evidence": "The unique test on dim_customers.customer_key failed with 1500 duplicate rows. dim_customers had 7500 rows but only 1500 distinct customer_key values, indicating each customer was duplicated. The source stg_customers has 1500 distinct customer_key rows, so duplication occurs in the dim_customers model. Inspecting its SQL revealed an incorrect join: `join {{ ref('stg_regions') }} r on n.region_key = n.region_key`, which is always true and creates a Cartesian product with all regions, inflating rows. Correcting the join to `r.region_key = n.region_key` restores a 1‑to‑1 relationship, yielding 1500 rows with unique customer_key. A trial patch with this fix passed all checks."
}
